Dear Professor Green, On behalf of the Student Union, I am honored to extend a cordial invitation for you to serve as a judge in our upcoming English Speech Contest.
The event is scheduled to take place in the University Hall from 2:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m. next Friday, with the theme of Cross-Cultural Communication. Several meaningful sessions have been arranged, including student speeches and live feedback. Knowing your keen interest in language teaching, we believe not only can your insights inspire all contestants, but they will also elevate the quality of the competition.
It would be deeply appreciated if you could accept our invitation and inform us of your availability before Wednesday. Yours sincerely, Li Ming

Much to my regret, an urgent academic data task assigned by our department this morning prevents me from leaving the campus tomorrow. Because of this unexpected assignment, it is impossible for me to arrive on time. To make up for the inconvenience caused, I would like to submit my reading notes in advance via email.

The thought-provoking cartoon vividly depicts two climbers scaling a steep mountain. While one stops halfway in exhaustion and chooses to quit, the other advances bravely toward the summit, wearing a determined look. Simple as the drawing may seem, it underscores the vital significance of perseverance on our path to success.
A multitude of factors easily account for this contrast. It is widely acknowledged that any lasting achievement demands steady effort rather than short bursts of enthusiasm. Unyielding perseverance empowers ordinary individuals to conquer severe obstacles, whereas the road to excellence is anything but smooth. Those who adhere to their goals tend to reap rewarding outcomes, while people indulging in excuses often fail to fulfill their potential. Not only can patience sharpen one's willpower, but it also lays a solid foundation for future growth.
In conclusion, nothing is more indispensable than cultivating unremitting tenacity. Challenging as our journey may appear, only when we persist through difficulties can we turn our ambitions into reality.

The satirical cartoon vividly depicts a family sitting around a dinner table, yet everyone is staring blankly at a smartphone screen instead of talking warmly. Beneath the drawing, a caption warns against the invisible digital wall separating loved ones in modern life. Such a striking scene merits our deep reflection on how digital tools reshape daily relationships.
Undeniably, mobile technology has exerted a far-reaching impact on modern society. On the one hand, digital innovations have made it remarkably convenient for people to access vast information and handle daily tasks efficiently. On the other hand, relying solely on virtual screens for happiness is far from wise, as countless individuals fail to realize the emotional cost of excessive use. Those indulging in endless short videos gradually lose patience for heartfelt communication, whereas families who cherish face-to-face moments build deeper mutual trust.
From what has been discussed above, we cannot attach too much importance to using technology rationally. Only by treating smartphones as helpful tools rather than letting them dominate our lives can we preserve true warmth in human relationships.
